params.usdcToken_: Must equal the Arc USDC address.                    Passed explicitly so the contract is verifiable but                    still fails loudly on a wrong-token deployment.

createInstruction(address,address,uint25.details: Caller must have approved this contract for `amount` USDC beforehand.

params.amount: Exact USDC amount (6 decimals) to lock and later pay.
params.expiry: Unix timestamp after which the sponsor may reclaim.                   Must be > block.timestamp and <= block.timestamp + 30 days.
params.refHash: Optional opaque reference (e.g. keccak256 of an invoice ID). Pass bytes32(0) if unused.
params.spender: Address authorised to execute the payment (exactly once, before expiry).

execute(uint256).details: Only callable by the designated spender, before expiry, and exactly once.

reclaim(uint256).details: Only callable by the original sponsor, after expiry.

ARC_USDC().notice: Arc USDC address (same on Arc Testnet and Arc Mainnet).

MAX_EXPIRY_WINDOW().notice: Maximum allowed expiry window: 30 days after block.timestamp at creation.

createInstruction(address,address,uint25.notice: Create a new payment instruction and lock the USDC.

execute(uint256).notice: Execute the payment. Sends USDC to the fixed recipient.

getInstruction(uint256).notice: Return the full state of an instruction.

nextInstructionId().notice: Return the next instruction ID that will be assigned.

reclaim(uint256).notice: Reclaim locked USDC after the instruction has expired without execution.

usdcToken().notice: The USDC ERC-20 token contract (immutable after construction).

@title PaymentAuthority
 @notice Immutable one-time delegated payment escrow.
         A sponsor locks USDC at instruction creation. Only the designated
         spender may execute the payment (to a fixed recipient, exact amount)
         before expiry. Only the sponsor may reclaim funds after expiry.
         Expiry must be within 30 days of creation.
         No admin, no fees, no upgrade, no oracle, no partial payments.
